---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

Example: "As a site foreman, I cannot currently export daily work logs to PDF.
I have to manually copy data from the bot into Excel."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like.

Example: "Add a `/rapor-pdf` command that generates a dated PDF summary
of the day's work log for a given site."

## Bot Interaction (if applicable)

How would a user interact with this feature?

```
User: /rapor-pdf
Bot: Hangi santiye?
     1. Site A
     2. Site B

User: 1
Bot: [PDF dosyasi eklendi] Site A — 1 Mayis 2026 raporu
```

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Affected Collections / Roles

Which Firestore collections would this touch?
Which user roles would use this feature? (patron / mudur / sef / satinalma)

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references, or extra context.
